locations.text: BUS101 Final. This assessment is untiered. 6 marks; 30 minutes. 1.1.1 Market research; 1.1.2 Market positioning; 2.1.1 Sources of finance. Short structured answers. Answer all questions. No calculator allowed.

1.1.1 Market research
a) Primary research: ethnographic observation and customer interviews.
b) Secondary research: published market reports; evaluate reliability and sampling bias.

1.1.1 Market research
c) Compare qualitative and quantitative methods and explain how sample size affects confidence in the findings.

1.1.2 Market positioning
a) Use a market map to compare price and quality.
b) Evaluate product differentiation and the usefulness of a unique selling proposition.

2.1.1 Sources of finance
a) Compare retained profit, bank loans, share capital and crowdfunding.
b) Explain how the choice depends on business size, risk, cost and repayment terms.
